title: Export wine only as the Wine Australia export regulations allow
what: Exporting a grape product in contravention of the Wine Australia regulations is an offence; the regulations set the export requirements.

sources.title: Wine Australia Act 2013
sources.quote: 44 Offences in relation to export of grape products (1) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person exports a grape product from Australia; and (b) the export of the grape product contravenes the regulations.
